CustomField.description:
INC0180752 This field Rolls up to Opportunity Field "Commission Fee Total (TCV)" Should be the same as "Commission_Amount__c" which is a formula field and cannot be used in Roll Up Summary field. Filled in by Flow "Commission Amount Update on Opportunity Partner" Only visible to System Admins for troubleshooting
05/13/2024 - Label changed as a part of the FY25 Partner Redesign project. Jira ticket SS--7685. Fields will be removed at a future date, likely in FY26.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatically populated by Salesforce with the amount from the Commission Amount (formula) field. This field is used in a rollup on the Opportunity for the Commission Fee Total (TCV) field.
CustomField.label: DEPRECATED - Commission Amount
